messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Esperanto, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Esperanto line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|--------------------|------------------------|--------| | Ond' | causal conjunction “wherefore” | **Do** | therefore / thus | OK | | io | 1st‑person singular pronoun (subject) | **mi** | I | OK | | per | preposition “for” (benefactive) | **por** | for | OK | | lo | definite article referring to the abstract noun “best” | — (omitted) | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | tuo | 2nd‑person possessive adjective “your” | **via** | your | OK | | me' | abstract noun “best / highest good” | **bono** | good | OK | | penso | verb “think” | **pensas** | think | OK | | e (1) | coordinating conjunction “and” | **kaj** | and | OK | | discerno | verb “deem / judge” | **taksas** | deem | OK | | che | subordinating conjunction “that” | **Ke** | that | OK | | tu | 2nd‑person pronoun (subject) | **vi** | you | OK | | mi (object) | 1st‑person pronoun (object) | **min** | me | OK | | segui | verb “follow” | **sekvas** | follow | OK | | e (2) | coordinating conjunction “and” | **kaj** | and | OK | | io (2) | 1st‑person pronoun (subject) | **mi** | I | OK | | sarò | future copular “will be” | **estos** | will be | OK | | tua | 2nd‑person possessive adjective “your” | **via** | your | OK | | guida | noun “guide” | **gvidanto** | guide | OK | | e (3) | coordinating conjunction “and” | **Kaj** | and | OK | | trarrotti | future transitive verb “will lead” | **kondukos** | will lead | OK | | di | preposition “from” | **de** | from | OK | | qui | adverb of place “here” | **ĉi tie** | here | OK | | per (2) | preposition “through” | **tra** | through | OK | | loco | noun “place” | **loko** | place | OK | | etterno | adjective “eternal” | **etrena** | eternal | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **lo** – marked **UNNECESSARY** because Esperanto does not use a definite article for the abstract noun “best”; the meaning is conveyed by the noun *bono* alone.
All other source words are correctly rendered (status **OK**).

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Esperanto script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Esperanto text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 112: - Original: **Do mi pensas kaj taksas ke tio estas por via bono** - Issue: none - Corrected: **Do mi pensas kaj taksas ke tio estas por via bono**
- Line 113: - Original: **Ke vi sekvas min, kaj mi estos via gvidanto,** - Issue: missing comma after “min” (the source has a comma there) - Corrected: **Ke vi sekvas min, kaj mi estos via gvidanto,**
- Line 114: - Original: **Kaj mi kondukos vin de ĉi tie tra la eterna loko;** - Issue: none - Corrected: **Kaj mi kondukos vin de ĉi tie tra la eterna loko;**
``` Do mi pensas kaj taksas ke tio estas por via bono Ke vi sekvas min, kaj mi estos via gvidanto, Kaj mi kondukos vin de ĉi tie tra la eterna loko; ```
